products.name: Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs. TCGplayer lists the box without a market price, so it is priced at 36 packs. Base Set 2 has no 1st Edition print.

products.name: 2-Player CD-ROM Starter Set
products.note: Two 30-card half decks (Fighting and Water) and a 1st Edition Base Set Machamp holo on cosmos foil (some copies Starlight), with the Pokémon Play It! CD-ROM, rulebook, damage counters, a custom coin, a card list and a playmat; released 2000-02-28 (Bulbapedia '2-Player CD-ROM Starter Set (TCG)', TCGplayer 107609, PokeBeach). The deck lists are not on record.

products.note: 60-card deck with a holofoil Clefairy (Bulbapedia and PokeBeach theme deck lists, TCGplayer 107611).
